violation_type.title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation made changes to the outside playground area and did not notify Child Care Regulations, that the changes were completed. Children were observed playing on the new play equipment.   The operation did not notify Child Care Regulations that they were moving classrooms and using one room that was unlicensed space.

finding_variants.text: The operation made changes to the outside playground area and did not notify Child Care Regulations, that the changes were completed. Children were observed playing on the new play equipment.   The operation did not notify Child Care Regulations that they were moving classrooms and using one room that was unlicensed space.
It was found that an unlicensed room in an adjacent building was being used by children during daycare hours.  The space will be repaired, measured and licensed by Child Care Regulation.
A change in classrooms has been made and change in space has occurred for the facility. This change occurred prior to notification Child Care Regulation.
Facility reduced indoor space and Child Care Regulation was not notified.
Observed one classroom removed without the operation providing notification to licensing.     NOTE: CORRECTED AT INSPECTION as notification was provided along with updated floor plan.
During the inspection the operation was caring for children in two unlicenced rooms within the facility.
